stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: She picked an apple from the tree.
items.sentenceZh: 她从树上摘下了一个苹果。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese apple orchard, one adult picks exactly one ripe apple from a branch and holds it as the clear focal object. The scene emphasizes a single countable apple; no other picked fruit, labels or letters.
items.altText: 中国果园里，一名采摘者从树上摘下一个苹果。

items.sentenceEn: She drew an outline of the mountain.
items.sentenceZh: 她画出了山的轮廓。
items.scene: Artist in a studio looks through a window at one distinctive mountain and traces only its outer contour as a clean line on blank paper, leaving inside empty. The real mountain and sketched outline visible side by side; no writing.
items.altText: 画者对照窗外的山峰，仅勾勒出外缘线条。

items.sentenceEn: Dr Chen examined the patient's hand.
items.sentenceZh: 陈医生检查了病人的手。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese community clinic, a physician wearing a plain coat gently examines an adult patient's hand while a nurse prepares supplies. Focus on medical doctor role, not doctorate ceremony; no name badge writing, logo or text.
items.altText: 中国社区诊所里，陈医生检查患者的手。

items.sentenceEn: Attendance at the rehearsal was high.
items.sentenceZh: 这次排练的出席人数很多。
items.scene: A contemporary Chinese community orchestra rehearsal with nearly every chair occupied by musicians holding instruments; conductor sees the full ensemble. Show many people present, a few empty chairs at edge, no attendance sheet or writing.
items.altText: 中国社区乐团排练时，绝大多数成员到场。

items.meaningZh: 他们的；她们的；它们的（名词性）
items.sentenceEn: The blue bicycles are theirs.
items.sentenceZh: 那些蓝色自行车是他们的。
items.scene: Two friends stand together beside their matching blue bicycles at a rack, each holding a helmet and pointing to the bikes, while a separate red bicycle stands apart. Composition makes shared ownership by that group clear; no labels.
items.altText: 两位朋友站在属于他们的蓝色自行车旁。

items.sentenceEn: The API lets the two apps exchange data.
items.sentenceZh: API 使两个应用程序交换数据。
items.scene: Two visually distinct software application panels connect through a clearly defined central interface gateway; one sends a small data tile and the other returns a response tile along arrows. Abstract digital diagram on a developer desk, no literal pipe, labels or text.
items.altText: 两个不同应用通过中央接口交换数据。

items.sentenceEn: There was speculation about what was inside the box.
items.sentenceZh: 人们纷纷猜测盒子里有什么。
items.scene: Several adults around a sealed unopened box imagine different possible contents in translucent thought bubbles, such as a toy, book and vase. Nobody knows yet; contrast uncertain guesses with hidden reality. No words.
items.altText: 人们看着未打开的盒子，猜测里面可能是什么。

items.meaningZh: 你们自己（复数反身代词）
items.sentenceEn: You can build the shelves yourselves.
items.sentenceZh: 你们可以自己动手搭建架子。
items.scene: Two adults assemble a wooden shelf together with safe hand tools, checking alignment and doing the work without a hired helper. Show both as direct agents of the action; no labels or text.
items.altText: 两个人不靠他人代劳，亲手组装木架。

items.meaningZh: 请求/响应载荷；有效载荷
items.sentenceEn: The payload carried the sensor readings to the server.
items.sentenceZh: 有效载荷把传感器读数送到了服务器。
items.scene: Cutaway of a digital network packet traveling from a weather sensor to server: outer envelope-like header surrounds a bright central payload of small pictorial temperature and humidity data tokens. Make information contents distinct from the packet wrapper; no numbers or letters.
items.altText: 网络数据包的中央载荷承载传感器数据发往服务器。

items.sentenceEn: The archaeologists uncovered an ancient mosaic.
items.sentenceZh: 考古人员发现并揭露了一幅古代马赛克。
items.scene: At a careful archaeological excavation, two adults brush away a thin layer of soil to reveal a colorful ancient floor mosaic; partly covered and newly exposed sections show discovery in progress. No artifact removal or writing.
items.altText: 考古人员轻轻刷去泥土，露出古代马赛克。

items.sentenceEn: Authentication confirmed her identity.
items.sentenceZh: 身份验证确认了她的身份。
items.scene: Adult user presents a fingerprint to a secure access scanner; a neutral pictorial portrait silhouette on a nearby screen aligns with her actual face, showing identity match before access decisions. No text, digits, real brand or surveillance threat.
items.altText: 用户通过指纹与身份资料匹配完成身份验证。

items.sentenceEn: She spoke on behalf of the residents.
items.sentenceZh: 她代表居民发言。
items.scene: At a neighborhood meeting, one adult spokesperson addresses organizers while a small group of residents stands behind her, listening and signaling agreement. She represents their collective view, not only herself; no placards or writing.
items.altText: 社区会议上，一人代表身后的居民发言。

items.sentenceEn: The manager gave authorization to enter the archive.
items.sentenceZh: 经理授权他进入档案室。
items.scene: After an access request, a manager deliberately approves a visitor's entry with a blank permission card; staff then opens an archive door. Show granting permission, not identity verification. No words, numeric codes or real seals.
items.altText: 经理批准进入档案室的请求，工作人员随后开门。

items.sentenceEn: The team developed an innovative solar device.
items.sentenceZh: 团队开发了一款创新的太阳能装置。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese renewable-energy lab, a diverse engineering team tests a novel compact foldable solar collector beside a familiar rigid panel, clearly showing the new functional design. Realistic engineering, no impossible perpetual motion, logo or text.
items.altText: 中国可再生能源实验室里，团队测试创新的折叠式太阳能装置。

items.sentenceEn: The deployment made the new app available to users.
items.sentenceZh: 部署完成后，新应用向用户开放。
items.scene: Developer team moves a finished application package from a test server into a live cloud server environment, with many user devices receiving the service afterward. Clear before-and-after release flow, visual blocks and arrows only, no screens with text or logos.
items.altText: 应用从测试环境部署到线上，随后可供多台用户设备使用。

items.sentenceEn: A shark swam past the reef.
items.sentenceZh: 一条鲨鱼游过珊瑚礁。
items.scene: A single anatomically accurate reef shark glides calmly past a healthy coral reef with fish keeping distance. Natural marine scene, no aggression, attack, blood or mythical proportions.
items.altText: 一条鲨鱼平静地从珊瑚礁旁游过。

items.sentenceEn: Docker packages the app and its tools together.
items.sentenceZh: Docker 把应用及其工具一起打包。
items.scene: On a developer's workstation, a single application symbol and its dependency-tool symbols are bundled inside one transparent isolated software container cube, then shown running consistently on another computer. Use conceptual computing imagery, not shipping docks, boats, whales, brand logos, text or code.
items.altText: 应用与依赖工具被打包进同一个软件容器，并在另一台电脑运行。

items.sentenceEn: Kubernetes manages containers across several servers.
items.sentenceZh: Kubernetes 跨多台服务器管理容器。
items.scene: An abstract orchestration control hub balances many small app-container cubes across three separate server racks; arrows show rescheduling one cube from a crowded rack to another after a fault. Clearly cluster coordination, not one container. No logos, wheel symbols, code or text.
items.altText: 中央编排系统协调多台服务器上的应用容器。

items.sentenceEn: The mill ground the grain into flour.
items.sentenceZh: 磨坊把谷物磨成面粉。
items.scene: At a traditional Chinese rural flour mill, grain pours into a turning stone grinding wheel and fine flour gathers below; adult miller guides process safely. Focus on milling transformation, not sawmill or factory, no labels.
items.altText: 中国乡村磨坊里，石磨把谷物磨成面粉。

items.sentenceEn: The installation of the new lights took all morning.
items.sentenceZh: 安装新灯具花了整整一上午。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese school hallway, qualified electricians on stable ladders attach new overhead light fixtures while power is safely off; one fixture remains boxed and another is secured and illuminated later as a subtle sequence. No exposed live wires or text.
items.altText: 中国学校走廊里，电工安全地安装新灯具。
